subject: Pen test cadence, evidence formats, and legacy-systems coverage
messages:
From: Laura Hayes <laura.hayes@acme-corp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test evidence + scope questions (Acme compliance)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick onboarding so far. Our compliance team asked me to confirm a few items related to the penetration test evidence for Redwood as part of our SIG/SOC2 intake:

- Can you confirm the scope of the last pen test (what services were in/out? Hosted API, Dedicated, Private deployments?)
- Which firm performed the test and what methodology (OWASP, NIST, red-team, etc.)? We need firm credentials for our vendor assessment.
- What is the date of the last full report and do you provide full workpapers or only a redacted summary?
- Our policy: critical findings must be retested within 90 days, other findings within 180 days. Do you have a remediation/retest cadence you follow?
- For legacy systems connected to inference (e.g., on-prem connectors, older VPC agents), do you include those in the assessment or are they out of scope?

I've attached the SIG questionnaire excerpt our security team wants answered (see attached). If easier, happy to hop on a short call.

Thanks,
Laura Hayes
Senior Security Manager, Acme Corp
laura.hayes@acme-corp.com
Attachment: SIG-questionnaire.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Hayes <laura.hayes@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test evidence + scope questions (Acme compliance)

Laura —

Thanks for the precise list; happy to clarify. Below is a concise summary and I attached our latest external-facing summary to speed your review. If your team needs workpapers we can share them under a standard NDA/SSAE-style request.

Scope of last assessment:
- Services tested: Hosted API (public control plane + inference path) and Redwood Dedicated (managed GPU pools).
- Private deployments: by default the customer-managed on-prem / VPC instances are out-of-scope for Redwood-run penetration tests unless Redwood is contracted to run the assessment on customer infra. For Acme we can include the Redwood-managed components that sit within your VPC connector (e.g., our routing/proxy layer) if you want.

Firm and methodology:
- Firm: PenTrust Labs (CREST-aligned consultancy)
- Methodology: hybrid approach — OWASP ASVS for web/API checks, NIST SP 800-115 techniques for host/network validation, and targeted auth/session testing. Not a full red-team lateral-movement exercise by default; that can be scoped separately.

Report / workpapers:
- Last full report date: 2026-04-13. Attached: redwood-pt-summary-2026-04.pdf (redacted executive summary + findings).
- Workpapers and raw log excerpts: available on request; require NDA and limited-scope access request.

Remediation & retest cadence:
- Our default SLA: critical/high findings — retest within 90 days after remediation; medium/low — retest within 180 days or tracked in the remediation log.
- We maintain a remediation-tracking CSV that maps findings -> PR/ticket -> remediation date -> retest result. Attached is our remediation-log-template.csv as an example.

Legacy/connector coverage:
- Legacy or customer-managed on-prem agents are "out of scope" for Redwood's hosted pen tests unless specifically included in the statement of work. We will, however: 1) provide testable endpoints we control, 2) share threat-model notes for connectors, and 3) collaborate on a combined assessment if Acme requests Redwood-led testing of connector components.

Next steps:
- If you confirm which assets/hosts you need covered (e.g., Hosted API public endpoints only, plus Dedicated control plane, OR include the VPC connector), we can provide a scoped statement of work and pricing.
- If Acme's compliance team needs workpapers, please send the NDA (or use the DocuSign link you prefer) and we'll route the documents through our security operations team.

Cc'd Rishi for details on private deployment offerings and Karthik for evidence transfer logistics.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security Programs (acting)
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-pt-summary-2026-04.pdf; remediation-log-template.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pen test evidence + scope questions (Acme compliance)

Stephanie — quick note to support the message above. For Private customers we have two paths:

1) Advisory + assist: Redwood provides the SOW, scoping, and remediation support; Acme arranges the assessment with a third-party and we coordinate evidence.
2) Managed assessment: Redwood engages PenTrust (or an approved partner) to run the customer-facing assessment for an additional fee; we can include legacy connector testing under this option.

Pricing and timing: managed assessment typically 4-6 weeks from kickoff; advisory path is shorter but depends on customer scheduling. I've attached a short pricing quote we use for Private assessments (ballpark).

Agree with the 90-day retest expectation for critical findings; we will capture that in the SOW.

-Rishi
Attachment: private-assess-pricing-quote.pdf

From: Laura Hayes <laura.hayes@acme-corp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test evidence + scope questions (Acme compliance)

Thanks — this is very helpful. A few quick follow-ups from Acme Compliance:

- For the SOC2 intake: does Redwood accept summary-only reports up to 12 months old for low-risk controls, or does Acme require full workpapers for anything older than 6 months? Our auditor tends to require workpapers for anything with medium/high findings within 12 months.
- Can you confirm PenTrust Labs' certs/accs (CREST membership ID or similar)? We'll include that in our vendor assessment.
- We'd like Redwood to include the VPC connector endpoints in scope for this engagement (if you can cover them under a managed assessment path, let's do that). Please send an SOW + ballpark cost and the DocuSign NDA link so our Legal can sign.

I'll schedule a 30-minute slot Thurs if that helps — please send availability. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME-67890 (for your GTM/sales coordination).

Laura
Senior Security Manager, Acme Corp
laura.hayes@acme-corp.com
